answers.core: Debugging Callables is probably needed on every project and a plugin would require a lot of working around.
answers.workaround:
It's possible to create your own string conversion function, but you'll have to always remember to use it:
```gdscript
static func to_call_string(c: Callable) -> String:
    return "<#%s>::%s" % [c.get_object_id(), c.get_method()]
```

title: Unify Callable to_string pattern and include the instance_id to match how Node, Resource, and Object look
